Who we are

A small practice with a big heart for neurodivergent kids

Cultivate Play, PLLC provides pediatric occupational therapy in children's natural environments: their homes, preschools, and community, as well as our office in Murfreesboro, TN. Neurodiversity-affirming, play-based care is what we do best.

Neurodiversity-affirming

We build on each child's strengths and honor how they experience the world, rather than trying to make them look "typical."

Child-led and play-based

Sessions follow the child's interests, with DIR Floortime woven into everything we do.

Real-life settings

Therapy happens in homes, preschools, and the community, where the skills matter most, plus our Murfreesboro office.

The role

Pediatric Occupational Therapist

You'll provide individualized, child-led therapy for kids with a wide range of needs, including autism, ADHD, and other disabilities. You'll design and carry out care plans built around each child's strengths, and partner closely with families, caregivers, and other professionals to support meaningful participation in everyday life.

This position begins in April 2027 as part-time maternity leave coverage. If you'd like more hours, you can grow your own caseload up to full time while you're covering. We'd love for the right person to stay on afterward with their own caseload, full time or part time.

At a glance
Schedule
Part-time maternity leave coverage from April 2027. You can build your own caseload up to full time during the coverage, then stay on full or part time.
Pay
Hourly, with paid documentation and admin time, paid cancellations, and mileage reimbursement
Where
Homes, preschools, the community, and our Murfreesboro office, mostly within Rutherford County
DIR Floortime
Training and certification required. Not certified yet? We'll pay for it.

What we're looking for

You might be a great fit if you have…

More than anything, we're looking for someone who genuinely believes in strengths-based, affirming care. One or more years of experience is preferred.

A valid Tennessee occupational therapy license, with a focus on pediatrics
DIR Floortime certification, or a willingness to become certified after you're hired
Strong knowledge of neurodiversity, child development and milestones, anatomy, physiology, neuroscience, and medical terminology
Experience supporting autistic and disabled children from a strengths-based approach
Confidence with affirming emotional regulation, interoception, and sensory processing interventions
Strong clinical reasoning, and comfort providing therapy in a family's home
Excellent communication skills for partnering with families and multidisciplinary teams
1+ years of experience (preferred, not required)

Benefits

We take care of the people who take care of kids

Every therapist gets paid documentation and admin time, paid cancellations, and mileage reimbursement from day one.

A truly flexible schedule

Set your own hours, whatever works best for you and your life. The one requirement: offer after-school appointments on at least 2 days a week.

The full benefits package starts once you reach full time, at 25 or more scheduled treatment sessions.

Paid time off

2 weeks a year to use anytime, plus about a week of paid days off between Christmas Eve and New Year's.

Paid holidays

Time to rest and be with the people you love.

Health coverage

Medical, dental, vision, and short-term disability insurance.

Professional liability insurance

Covered by the practice.

DIR Floortime training

Paid training and certification, or a CEU stipend if you're already certified.

Mentorship

Ongoing support and guidance from an experienced, DIR-Proficient OT.
